- step 9 ✅ host run (Wakeel.Admin.exe، منفذ ⁧9334⁩، ⁧1366×768⁩، مجلد بيانات مؤقّت): drove A01 → recovery sheet → A03 → A04/A05/A06/A07 with real data (دائرتان، قسم، وحدة مكتب برمز INV-1042، ثلاثة أجهزة بالأدوار الثلاثة، مفتاح مكتب، تفعيل، إلغاء جهاز موقّع)، screenshotted every screen in dark and light beside its A-preview، host log clean، process killed. Fixed in the host what the run actually showed: (1) the built-in letter template was read twice — Word writes every drawing once for itself and once as an mc:Fallback, so the letterhead's six marks were counted ×٢ and every letterhead line was drawn twice in the A4 preview; the reader now skips mc:Fallback and reads headers → body → footers, so the sheet reads like a letter (regression test added). (2) the bar's organisation line said «لا دوائر» while A05 showed two — AdminPageHeaderState.Refresh() + the layout re-reading on every header change + A05.Reload() raising it. (3) WCard's neutral variant never draws Desc, so seven cards lost the line under their title (A04 logo/report/letter، A05 المكتب والجرد، A06 الأجهزة، A07 الحسابات/المفتاح/قائمة الإلغاء): they now carry WSectionHeader inside the card. (4) A06 drew two cards by hand (قائمة المكاتب، ترويسة المكتب) — both are WCard + WSectionHeader now، and the grid became ⁧300px⁩ + rest so the devices table stopped scrolling sideways. (5) A07's grid became rest + ⁧360px⁩ for the same reason. (6) A05's detail form was ragged (field، pair، field): all four fields now sit two to a row، and the parent chooser shows the parent's name (the whole path no longer fits a field and was cut mid-word) with the path spelled out in the line under it. (7) the appearance switch offered «المظهر الداكن» on a screen that was already dark — until a choice is made the tool follows the computer، so the bar now asks the page what it is actually drawing (wakeelAdmin.isDrawnDark). (8) wording brought to the preview: «حفظ التغييرات»، «شعار الهيئة»، «صيغة ترقيم الملفات» with the item-5 caution always in the card، «قالب التقرير الشهري (اختياري)»، «يوم بداية الدورة المالية (١–٢٨)»، «مكتب في الهيكلية»، و«جهازان … بحاجة إلى ملف إعداد جديد» بدل «تحتاج». 156/156 tests green.
